concept: Historical strategy game UI asset, fictional organizational emblem with no slogans. Paired-endpoint composition: a large globe centered upper middle, six blank flagpoles arranged symmetrically behind it, a monumental two-pillar rectangular congress entrance below, small abstract civilian delegate silhouettes in orderly close rows across lower third. Cool blue-grey sculpted iron material on globe, architecture and figures, dark burgundy backing, antique gold wreath. Dense symmetrical architectural relief representing centralized international organization. No real political leader, no weapons or military uniforms. Preserve this exact globe/flags/entrance/civilian arrangement for a later warm variant.
